TITLE — typeset this exact headline, large, high-contrast, in the vertical middle 60% of the frame. No other words, no byline, no watermark, no logo:
Bounded agents: give your robot a door, a sandbox, and an exit

SUBJECT
Design SDLC agents with a defined entry point, scoped access, a clear exit condition, and an observable trace — so when one misbehaves you can tell why.

NOTES
The first time you let an agent touch your codebase it feels like autocomplete with delusions of grandeur. The model suggests, you accept or reject, you are always in control. Fine. That is the safe version. Then someone wires it into the pipeline. Now it plans, implements, reviews, opens the PR. The supervision drops from "every keystroke" to "every so often."
